name: Budget-Friendly Clean Lunches
equipment: A lunch container and pantry staples (rice, beans, canned tuna)
instructions: Rely on affordable staples -- rice, beans, canned fish, frozen vegetables, eggs -- as the backbone of clean eating on a budget.
Buy produce in season and frozen vegetables when fresh is pricey; frozen veg is picked and flash-frozen at peak nutrition.
Cook a big batch of a cheap base (rice, beans) once and rotate it into different flavor profiles through the week.
Watch today's video for five easy, cheap lunch ideas.
